main.summary: Catalog grain contract for querying, publishing, and token-fenced lifecycle management of catalog items.

method.name: AddUpdate
method.summary: Creates or updates an active catalog item only for the supplied item instance token.
method.param: Item descriptor to create or update.
Candidate or current token for this continuous item instance.

method.name: BeginDelete
method.summary: Marks the current item instance as pending deletion.
method.param: Item identifier to mark for deletion.
method.returns: The current item identity, or when absent.

method.name: FinalizeDelete
method.summary: Removes the pending item only when its current token matches the supplied token.
method.param: Expected token for the item instance being deleted.

method.name: GetItemIdentity
method.summary: Returns the token for an active item, excluding items pending deletion.
method.returns: The active item identity, or when absent or pending deletion.

method.name: GetItemState
method.summary: Returns the current item token and pending-delete state.
method.returns: The current item state, or when absent.

method.name: GetPendingDeletes
method.summary: Returns a keyset-paged list of items pending deletion.
method.param: Exclusive item-ID continuation key, or to start at the beginning.
Maximum number of items to return; must be between 1 and 500.
method.returns: A page of pending-delete item identities and the next continuation key.

method.name: Exists
method.summary: Checks whether an item exists as an active catalog item.
method.returns: when the active item exists, when absent or pending deletion, or when the query fails.

method.name: SearchCommands
method.summary: Searches active catalog items and their commands using the supplied filters and paging options.
method.param: Optional command search filters and page request.
method.returns: Matching command results and any continuation token.

method.name: SearchElements
method.summary: Searches active catalog items using the supplied element filters and paging options.
method.param: Optional element search filters and page request.
method.returns: Matching element results and any continuation token.

method.name: SearchMedia
method.summary: Searches active catalog items and their media metadata using the supplied filters and paging options.
method.param: Optional media search filters and page request.
method.returns: Matching media results and any continuation token.

method.name: SearchNotes
method.summary: Searches note values associated with active catalog items.
method.param: Optional note terms and page request.
method.returns: Matching item identifiers and any continuation token.

method.name: SearchServices
method.summary: Searches active catalog items and their service metadata using the supplied filters and paging options.
method.param: Optional service search filters and page request.
method.returns: Matching service results and any continuation token.

method.name: SearchTags
method.summary: Searches tag values associated with active catalog items.
method.param: Optional tag terms and page request.
method.returns: Matching item identifiers and any continuation token.
